description: Calculates multi-tier employee compensation, grade-based treatment bonuses, diligence rewards, attendance deductions, and recruiter/trainer commission splits across arbitrary date ranges.
implementation_notes: Implemented in app/Services/CompensationService.php and app/Http/Controllers/CompensationController.php. Interacts with employees, grades, bonus, attendance, shifts, sessions, and sales_records tables.

description: Handles serialized voucher generation, batch inventory range tracking, customer purchase association, and cross-session redemption validation.
implementation_notes: Implemented in app/Http/Controllers/VoucherController.php and app/Http/Controllers/CartController.php. Interacts with voucher, treatments, sales, sessions, and sales_records tables.

description: Manages appointment bookings with simultaneous resource constraints including bed/room availability, therapist assignments, and real-time session status transitions.
implementation_notes: Implemented in app/Http/Controllers/SessionController.php. Interacts with sessions, beds, rooms, employees, customers, and treatments tables.

description: Detects booking overlaps across staff and rooms, logs conflict audit trails, computes alternative candidate time slots, and supports one-click customer rescheduling.
implementation_notes: Implemented in app/Http/Controllers/ConflictController.php. Interacts with conflicts, sessions, employees, and branches tables.

description: Enforces post-session customer feedback windows, dispatches async background NLP sentiment scoring, surfaces negative feedback alerts, and generates executive AI summaries.
implementation_notes: Implemented in app/Http/Controllers/FeedbackController.php, app/Http/Controllers/SentimentController.php, app/Jobs/SentimentAnalysisJob.php, and app/Ai/Agents/SentimentSummaryAgent.php. Interacts with feedbacks and sessions tables.

description: Provides automated double-entry financial journaling, linking income/expense line items directly to ledger debit/credit accounts and branch balance sheets.
implementation_notes: Implemented in app/Http/Controllers/AccountController.php, app/Http/Controllers/JournalController.php, app/Http/Controllers/IncomeController.php, and app/Http/Controllers/ExpenseController.php. Interacts with accounts, journals, journal_records, incomes, and expenses tables.

description: Synchronizes attendance logs directly from ZKTeco biometric IP hardware devices, matches check-ins against scheduled shifts, and calculates late/early leave penalties.
implementation_notes: Implemented in app/Services/AttendanceSyncService.php and app/Http/Controllers/AttendanceController.php. Interacts with attendance, shifts, and employees tables.

description: Generates personalized service recommendations based on rolling customer history and branch contextual availability, with automatic fallback to popular items.
implementation_notes: Implemented in app/Services/RecommendationService.php, app/Http/Controllers/RecommendationController.php, and app/Ai/Agents/RecommendationAgent.php. Interacts with sessions and treatments tables.

description: Conversational AI assistant powered by LLM agents for customer booking guidance and staff operational metric querying with dynamic database context.
implementation_notes: Implemented in app/Services/ChatbotService.php, app/Http/Controllers/ChatbotController.php, app/Ai/Agents/CustomerChatAgent.php, and app/Ai/Agents/StaffChatAgent.php. Interacts with agent_conversations and agent_conversation_messages tables.

description: Processes point-of-sale checkout transactions with split-payment capabilities across cash, EDC card terminals, e-wallets, QR codes, and pre-purchased vouchers.
implementation_notes: Implemented in app/Http/Controllers/SalesController.php and app/Http/Controllers/CartController.php. Interacts with sales, sales_records, income_payments, and wallets tables.
